requirements.scope: Candidate signed Fedora build RPMs for the exact portal/toolkit pair, reusing the retained compositor prefix; discovery only
notes: Reuse the existing reviewed compositor build requirements to satisfy the retained prefix pkg-config dependency closure; do not rebuild the compositor or its ten existing source components
The selected portal requires PipeWire >=1.1.82, wayland-protocols >=1.39, sdbus-c++ >=2.0.0 and the retained hyprland-protocols >=0.8.0
Build the matching hyprtoolkit >=0.6.0 share-picker dependency from pinned source; iniparser and absl_flat_hash_map are its additional Fedora providers
Resolve only the reviewed Fedora 45 release/update repositories; verify and pin every candidate before a separate offline build; CMake must enforce upstream version constraints
No installation, compilation, screen-share consent or OS qualification is implied by this discovery profile
